answer: Anti-sybil: rate-limited mint backed by hashcash proof-of-work. Step 1: node publishes an epoch nonce; claimant solves 2^26 partial SHA-256 collisions, about 67 million hashes, 3.4 seconds on a 20 MH/s GPU. Step 2: the contract locks a 250 POA bond and stamps a 72-hour cooldown on the hardware fingerprint. Step 3: the beacon samples one mint per block, duplicates get slashed and blacklisted. Cost: 500 clones need 125,000 POA, 36 GPU-hours at $0.35 each, 34 billion hashes. Like 500 threads through a gale: each beats the same pulse of work, and the storm keeps count.
